description: Unkey provides API management and compute hosting for deploying apps behind a gateway, issuing and verifying API keys, enforcing rate limits, and managing permissions and analytics. Its platform spans workspace administration, root-key-based API access, hosted MCP tooling, and a command-line interface.
summary: Unkey exposes one bearer-authenticated HTTP API at api.unkey.com, two hosted MCP servers on mcp.unkey.com that take a root key header, and an `unkey` CLI that authenticates either via `unkey login` device flow or a root key.
